senses.gloss:
(टु उ) टुवमु r. 1st cl. (वमति)
To vomit, to eject from the mouth.

mf. (-मः-मी)
Vomiting.
E.
वम to vomit, aff. अच्; also वमन and वमि.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Left, not right.
2 Reverse, contrary, inverted.
3 Beautiful, pleasing.
4 Vile, base, wicked.
5 Short.
6 Crooked.
m. (-मः)
1 A name of ŚIVA.
2 KĀMA or CUPID.
3 An udder, a breast.
4 A potherb, (Chenopodium album.)
5 An animal, a sentient being.
6 A snake.
n. (-मं)
Wealth, possessions.
f. (-मा)
1 A woman.
2 GAURĪ.
3 LAKṢMĪ.
4 SARASVATĪ.
f. (-मी)
1 A mare.
2 A she-ass.
3 A young female elephant.
4 The female of the jackal.
E.
वा to go, Uṇādi aff. मन्.

m. (-थुः)
1 Vomiting, ejecting any thing from the mouth.
2 Water ejected from an elephant's trunk.
E.
वम to vomit, aff. अथुच्.

n. (-नं)
1 Vomiting, ejecting any thing from the mouth.
2 Causing vomiting, an emetic.
3 Pain.
4 Offering oblations to fire.
E.
वम to vomit, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Short, dwarfish, a dwarf.
2 Depressed, pressed flat or down.
3 Low, vile, base.
m. (-नः)
1 VIṢṆU in his character of the dwarf, in which he appeared on his fifth [] descent from heaven, to prevent BALI from obtaining dominion of the three worlds.
2 The elephant that supports the south quarter.
3 A tree, (Alangium hexapetalum.)
f. (नी)
1 A female dwarf.
2 A sort of woman; also वामनिका.
3 A disease of the vagina.
E.
वम to eject from the mouth, and ल्यु or ल्युट् aff.

f. (-मिः)
1 Vomiting, sickness.
2 An emetic.
m. (-मिः)
1 A name of fire.
2 A rogue, a cheat.
E.
वम to vomit, aff. इन्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sickened, made to vomit.
E.
वम to be sick, causal v., क्त aff.

ind.
Having vomited or been sick.
E.
वम to be sick, क्त्वा aff.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Vomiting, sick.
E.
वम to vomit, इनि aff.

f. (-म्री)
A small ant burrowing in trees; also वम्रा.

n. (-टं)
An ant-hill, a hillock.
E.
वम्री a sort of ant, कूट a heap.

f. (-ता)
1 Perverseness, contrariety.
2 Craftiness, wickedness.
3 Loveliness.
E.
तल् added to वाम; also with त्व, वामत्वं.

m. (-वः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
वाम contrary, (to human institutions,) देव who sports.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Shortened, flattened.
E.
वामन, and कृत made, with च्चि augment.

m. (-रः)
An ant or mole hill, especially the hillocks of ground thrown up by the white ant.
E.
वाम inverted, reversed, लू to cut, aff. रक्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Fine-eyed.
f. (-ना)
A handsome woman.
E.
वाम beautiful, and लोचन eye.

f. (-क्षी)
A handsome woman.
E.
वाम beautiful, and अक्षि an eye.

m. (-रः)
The doctrine of the Tantras according to one system.
E.
वाम left, and आचार institute; the left hand ritual, the use of flesh, spirits, &c. forming part of the Vāmācāra ceremonies.

m. (-री)
A follower of the left hand portion of the Tantras.
E.
वामाचार, and इनि aff.

m. (-नः)
A tree, (Salvadora Persica, &c.): see पीलु.

m. (-र्त्तः)
A conch shell with the spiral turn running from right to left.
E.
वाम, and आवर्त्त a turn.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Proud, haughty, intolerant.
2 Handsome, beautiful.
E.
वम to eject from the mouth, (the faults of others,) aff. इलच्.
